stories.title: Rebel returns to AEW TV during Britt Baker's Dynamite match
stories.tldr: AEW hosted a special Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite on September 9, 2026, dedicated to raising ALS awareness and honoring Tanea Rebel Brooks alongside tributes to the late Andy The Butcher Williams. The emotional broadcast featured the return of The Waiting Room talk show hosted by Dr. Britt Baker and Rebel, followed by Baker's first in-ring match in nearly two years. Rebel made a triumphant return to ringside to hand Baker her signature glove, helping secure the victory in a six-woman tag team match. The evening concluded with a touching, tearful celebration as Baker and Rebel embraced at the top of the ramp amid a standing ovation from the crowd.

stories.title: AEW signs former MLW Women's Champion Janai Kai
stories.tldr: AEW has reportedly signed former MLW Women's World Featherweight Champion Janai Kai to a contract, though company sources have not yet confirmed whether it is a full-time agreement or a per-appearance deal. Kai has built an extensive independent resume and a familiar presence on Ring of Honor programming, building upon earlier AEW appearances from 2021 and 2022. Her arrival introduces a decorated former champion to the broader AEW and Ring of Honor ecosystem.

stories.title: Matches and card announced for September 16 AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: The September 16 episode of AEW Dynamite in Norfolk, Virginia, is shaping up as a crucial stop on the road to the All Out pay-per-view. The card currently features a marquee six-man tag team match involving AEW World Champion Will Ospreay and his upcoming challenger Jon Moxley, alongside a heated singles bout between Chris Jericho and Nick Wayne. With multiple overlapping storylines and personal vendettas colliding, more matches and segments are expected to be added to the lineup as the event approaches.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland & New Level retain AEW World Trios Titles against Conglomeration
stories.tldr: Swerve Strickland and The New Level successfully defended their AEW World Trios Championships against The Conglomeration to kick off AEW Dynamite: Rebel Heart. Following the chaotic opening match, the champions were immediately confronted by Ricochet and The Demand demanding a rematch, though former champions Hangman Adam Page, Brody King, and Bandido ultimately intervened. Meanwhile, industry veteran Jim Cornette has voiced skepticism regarding the long-term career trajectory and overall business impact of The New Level following their recent promotion change.

stories.title: Orange Cassidy comments on signature look, MJF rivalry, and wanting to play The Flash
stories.tldr: AEW star Orange Cassidy recently revealed that he is considering retiring his iconic 2017 denim jacket after nearly a decade of use. He also took a sharp jab at rival MJF, claiming the star has terrible body odor and doesn't wash his hands enough. Additionally, Cassidy shared his surprising Hollywood aspirations, stating he would love to play The Flash in James Gunn's DC Universe for the comedic irony while defending the recent Superman film.

stories.title: AEW star Taya Valkyrie joins The Traitors Canada season 4 cast
stories.tldr: AEW and Ring of Honor star Taya Valkyrie has been announced as one of 22 contestants for the upcoming fourth season of The Traitors Canada. She joins a diverse cast for the reality competition, which is hosted by Karine Vanasse and features alumni from Big Brother Canada and Survivor. The new season is scheduled to premiere on September 21, 2026, on CTV, with streaming available the next day on Crave. Players will compete for a grand prize of up to $100,000, though it remains unconfirmed whether Valkyrie will be playing as a faithful or a traitor.

stories.title: Claudio Castagnoli accepts Shingo Takagi's challenge for NJPW Destruction in Kobe
stories.tldr: AEW star Claudio Castagnoli has officially accepted Shingo Takagis challenge for a high-profile singles match at NJPW Destruction in Kobe on September 27. Takagi called out Castagnoli after blaming the AEW star for disrupting his momentum and causing his disappointing performance in the recent G1 Climax tournament. In a video message responding to the challenge, Castagnoli mocked Takagis complaints and promised to teach him another lesson in the ring. This upcoming encounter marks the very first singles match between the two seasoned veterans.

stories.title: AEW stars set to make debuts in New Japan Pro-Wrestling
stories.tldr: Since 2021, the established partnership between All Elite Wrestling and New Japan Pro-Wrestling has allowed several top stars to cross over and compete in Japan. Building on this successful cross-promotional relationship, numerous prominent AEW roster members are prime candidates to make their eventual NJPW debuts. Speculation and potential booking scenarios highlight eight specific acts, ranging from dominant veterans like Bobby Lashley to high-flyers and rising talent, who could make a major impact overseas.

stories.title: AEW tag team reportedly heading toward a breakup
stories.tldr: The AEW tag team division is experiencing a surge in talent with recent arrivals like The New Level and the Motor City Machine Guns, which may lead to several existing alliances dissolving. Speculation points toward potential splits or friction for three notable acts, including Brodido, The Opps, and the mentorship bond between Will Ospreay and Callum Newman. These possible breakups could set up major singles feuds, championship matches, and faction realignments as the competitive landscape in the company continues to evolve.

stories.title: Vince Russo offers critique on AEW booking of former WWE stars
stories.tldr: Former WWE head writer Vince Russo recently shared his critique regarding how All Elite Wrestling books talent that previously worked for WWE. Russo argues that Tony Khan and the creative team must focus on providing these established performers with meaningful character material and clear narrative direction rather than just relying on their in-ring abilities. According to Russo, simply having great matches is not enough to make former WWE stars stand out if they lack distinctive storylines. Without proper creative backing, he warns that these major acquisitions risk blending into the rest of the roster.

stories.title: AEW pays tribute to late wrestler Andy 'The Butcher' Williams
stories.tldr: Following his tragic passing at age 48, All Elite Wrestling honored the late Andy The Butcher Williams during the September 9 episode of Dynamite with an opening graphic and deeply emotional commentary tributes. AEW also announced a further tribute for the upcoming September 12 episode of Collision. Additionally, a public celebration of life event featuring acoustic musical performances has been scheduled for September 27 in his hometown of Buffalo, New York.

stories.title: Sting's son Steven Borden makes victorious AEW TV debut on Dynamite
stories.tldr: Steven Borden successfully made his televised AEW in-ring debut on Dynamite, teaming with Darby Allin to defeat Josh Alexander and Mark Davis. Despite early pressure from the Don Callis Family, Borden showcased his athleticism and power in front of the Athens crowd. He ultimately secured the victory by pinning Alexander with a Scorpion Coffin Drop.

stories.title: Kofi Kingston and The New Level reflect on AEW debut alongside Prince Nana
stories.tldr: Kofi Kingston recently discussed the full circle nature of debuting alongside Prince Nana during The New Level's arrival in AEW. Kofi explained that Nana's indie career years ago actually prevented him from using a Ghanaian gimmick when he first started in WWE. Now aligned in the same stable, the veterans are enjoying their new chapter together.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite Rebel Heart event ticket sales and start time details
stories.tldr: Ahead of tonight's Rebel Heart edition of AEW Dynamite in Athens, Georgia, ticket sales have reached 2,235 distributed seats, outpacing the venue's previous Collision event. The broadcast kicks off at 8:00 PM Eastern on TBS and HBO Max. The stacked lineup features Will Ospreay facing David Finlay in an eliminator match, a Trios Championship bout, a tables match, and the return of The Waiting Room hosted by Britt Baker and Rebel.

stories.title: Andrade fulfills weekly AEW National Championship defense promise
stories.tldr: Continuing his newly minted weekly defense strategy, AEW National Champion Andrade El Idolo put his title on the line against Beast Mortos on Dynamite. After successfully retaining the championship through a hard-fought battle, Andrade was blindsided by The Dogs. Fortunately, AEW World Champion Will Ospreay ran out to make the save and thwart the ambush.

stories.title: AEW adds late championship match to September 9 Dynamite broadcast
stories.tldr: AEW is hosting the Rebel Heart special episode of Dynamite in Athens, Georgia, to honor Tanea Brooks following her terminal ALS diagnosis. To bolster an already loaded card, officials have added a last-minute championship match to the broadcast. Andrade El Idolo will put the AEW National Championship on the line against LFIs The Beast Mortos. Mortos stepped up to answer Andrades ongoing open challenge for the belt.

stories.title: AEW adds new matches to upcoming All Out 2026 pay-per-view card
stories.tldr: AEW is shaping up the card for its upcoming All Out pay-per-view in Chicago on September 26 following the success of All In London. Mercedes Mone is expected to defend her Women's World Championship against Thekla after a recent television confrontation. Meanwhile, newly crowned Trios Champions The New Level and National Champion Andrade El Idolo are both heading toward major potential matches on the growing card.

stories.title: Status and future plans regarding Kenny Omega's AEW return
stories.tldr: Following his recent championship loss, Kenny Omega's eventual return to AEW has opened the door to several major feuds and dream matches. Creative plans reportedly range from a world title rematch with Will Ospreay and a grudge match against Kyle Fletcher to fresh bouts with Speedball Mike Bailey and debuting star Ilja Dragunov. Omega could also reignite his rivalry with Kazuchika Okada or reunite The Elite to target the World Trios Champions.

stories.title: Analysis of AEW search engine trends following All In spike
stories.tldr: Despite the massive search spike generated by AEW All In, overall search interest for the promotion has remained flat year-on-year and quickly returned to pre-event levels. Data shows that subsequent traffic bumps were largely driven by external events, such as the passing of wrestler Andy Williams, rather than sustained organic growth. Regional metrics highlight West Virginia as a primary hotspot for AEW search queries, aligning with the promotion's upcoming live event schedule in the state.

stories.title: WWE Women's World Champion Liv Morgan cast in thriller movie 'Ping'
stories.tldr: WWE Womens World Champion Liv Morgan has joined the cast of the upcoming psychological thriller movie Ping, directed by Richie Gordon. The film explores modern burnout culture and follows a creative director forced to choose between her sanity and an inescapable boss. Morgan will play a character named Jess alongside stars like Megan Lawless, with production currently underway in Mississippi. This adds to Morgan's growing acting résumé, which also includes a role in the upcoming film Bad Lieutenant: Tokyo.

stories.title: Ethan Page addresses WWE locker room dynamics, fan criticism, and career goals
stories.tldr: WWE Raw Superstar Ethan Page recently addressed locker room dynamics, fan manipulation, and his career ambitions during an interview. He claimed that every wrestler in the company is a liar focused primarily on money and ego, while positioning himself as the only authentic person willing to admit his flaws. Page also criticized modern wrestlers for reacting defensively to online negativity from fans and outlined his long-term goals of winning major championships and building a lasting legacy based on peer respect rather than just short-term popularity.

stories.title: Nick Khan reveals WWE already has creative plans set for WrestleMania 43
stories.tldr: WWE President Nick Khan revealed that the company has already mapped out its creative plans and storylines for WrestleMania 43, which will be held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in 2027. This marks the historic first time WWE's flagship event will take place outside of the United States or Canada. While the creative direction is set subject to potential injuries, exact dates have not yet been announced. To accommodate domestic fans, WWE will host watch parties and events featuring NXT and AAA at the Theater at Madison Square Garden in New York.

stories.title: CM Punk set for Netflix's Hot Ones: Extra Heat challenge after Raw
stories.tldr: Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk is scheduled to face the Wings of Death on Netflix's Hot Ones: Extra Heat immediately following the live September 14 episode of Monday Night Raw. Hosted by Sean Evans, this will be only the second episode of the spinoff series, which debuted in July with Will Ferrell, Jimmy Tatro, and Fortune Feimster. The spicy challenge comes amidst a busy schedule for Punk, who is also set to defend his title against Sami Zayn on the September 11 episode of SmackDown in Mexico. Although Punk previously appeared alongside his wife AJ Lee on Hot Ones Versus in January, this upcoming special marks his first time taking on the complete 10-wing lineup.

stories.title: Corey Graves addresses potential in-ring return and medical clearance
stories.tldr: WWE commentator Corey Graves has revealed that he quietly secured medical clearance to return to the ring several years ago, though a potential comeback did not materialize at the time. After growing stagnant following that missed opportunity, Graves has spent the last several months back in the gym testing his physical condition. He specifically named Mexico based promotion AAA as a fun potential destination to follow in the footsteps of his younger brother, Sam Adonis. While no official match has been announced and he remains a fixture at the commentary desk, Graves is officially leaving the door open to a possible in ring return.

stories.title: WWE expands collaboration and talent participation with Lucha Libre AAA
stories.tldr: WWE President Nick Khan has highlighted significant audience growth for Lucha Libre AAA following strategic international streaming choices and the promotion's recent acquisition. Meanwhile, main roster WWE stars are reportedly eager to participate in AAA events, finding a refreshing alternative to their regular schedules. Anticipation is now ramping up for major upcoming shows, including the two-night TripleMania 34 extravaganza and the upcoming Worlds Collide premium live event in Chicago.

stories.title: WWE launches first Spanish-language podcast WWE Ahora
stories.tldr: WWE has launched its first-ever Spanish-language podcast, titled WWE Ahora, in partnership with Fanatics. Hosted by Andrea Bazarte and Eduardo Bates, the weekly series covers news from both WWE and AAA, marking the first official podcast dedicated to the latter. The debut episode dropped alongside a major slate of Latin American live events and the historic two-night, two-country AAA TripleManía 34 weekend. Full video episodes are available on the WWE Español YouTube channel, with audio versions coming to major podcast platforms.

stories.title: NXT star Jaida Parker says WWE main roster call-up is inevitable
stories.tldr: NXT standout Jaida Parker recently expressed complete confidence that her eventual call-up to the WWE main roster is inevitable. Speaking on radio, Parker noted that her ability to go toe-to-toe with top talent like Lola Vice proves she belongs on the big stage. Although she has yet to capture championship gold in NXT despite multiple high-profile opportunities, she remains focused on self-improvement while supporting her peers and former stablemates who have already made the jump.

stories.title: IYO SKY provides update regarding her recent WWE television absence
stories.tldr: IYO SKY has addressed her nearly month-long absence from WWE television following her August 10 appearance on Monday Night RAW. She revealed that she was not injured, but rather took a personal summer vacation back home in Tokyo, Japan. The former Womens World Champion has now concluded her time off and is heading straight to the WWE South America tour. WWE has not yet announced her official return date to television.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes discusses acting experience prior to Street Fighter movie
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes recently reflected on his transition into acting, highlighting his positive cameo experience in The Naked Gun reboot alongside Liam Neeson as preparation for his major role as Guile in the upcoming Street Fighter movie. Directed by Kitao Sakurai and featuring fellow WWE star Roman Reigns as Akuma, the film hits theaters in October 2026. Ahead of the movie's release, Legendary Comics announced a prequel graphic novel featuring backstories for characters like Guile and M. Bison, further bridging the worlds of professional wrestling and cinematic martial arts.

stories.title: Stephanie McMahon recalls story of Ric Flair confronting Eric Bischoff
stories.tldr: During an appearance on Stephanie McMahon's podcast What's Your Story, Charlotte Flair revealed that her father, Ric Flair, deeply struggled mentally with being forced to cut his signature hair during their time in WCW. Charlotte explained that losing his trademark look made the Nature Boy feel unrecognizable, noting that no one even knew who he was the first time he walked through the airport afterward. Prompted by this revelation, Stephanie McMahon recalled receiving a phone call years later reporting that a long-grudging Ric had finally snapped and punched Eric Bischoff in the face.

stories.title: Danhausen details quick WWE face paint routine and pitches Simpsons role
stories.tldr: WWE star Danhausen recently discussed his signature look, revealing that he has perfected his face paint routine down to just five minutes. Speaking with BANG Showbiz, he joked that he frequently wears the makeup in public to fend off overwhelming attention from his Fanhausens. Beyond the squared circle, Danhausen pitched a dream guest role on The Simpsons for a Treehouse of Horror special and proposed his own sitcom concept featuring celebrity guests like Conan O'Brien and Weird Al Yankovic.

stories.title: Rhea Ripley opens up about bodily physical toll from wrestling and gear
stories.tldr: WWE superstar Rhea Ripley recently opened up about the heavy physical toll that professional wrestling and constant travel have taken on her body. During a visit from fitness personality Jesse James West to her home gym, Ripley detailed how wear and tear has affected her lower back, hips, and knees. These physical limitations have directly influenced her training regimen, leading her to favor machine-based exercises like the pendulum squat over traditional barbell squats to protect her joints.

stories.title: Nick Khan addresses WWE fan complaints regarding ESPN premium live event accessibility
stories.tldr: WWE President Nick Khan recently addressed fan backlash regarding accessibility issues with Premium Live Events on ESPN following their streaming partnership. During an appearance on The Varsity with John Ourand, Khan admitted that some fan criticisms carry truth and prompt minor adjustments, though he warned against companies becoming overly reactive to public opinion. He praised WWE's internal leadership, specifically creative head Paul Triple H Levesque, and pointed to the ongoing financial growth of TKO properties as proof that their overall business strategy is succeeding.

stories.title: Sol Ruca envisions WrestleMania entrance with her father's band
stories.tldr: WWE star Sol Ruca has big family-friendly ambitions for her eventual WrestleMania debut. During a recent podcast appearance, she revealed her dream to have her father Paul A Hampton and his band The Skeletones perform her entrance music live. Ruca is actively speaking this goal into existence and hopes to pitch the idea to WWE management.

stories.title: Grayson Waller praises CM Punk for helping talent backstage in WWE
stories.tldr: NXT Champion Grayson Waller recently discussed CM Punk's WWE return and confirmed that the veteran genuinely helps younger talent backstage, frequently reviewing tape with rookies. However, while acknowledging Punk's positive backstage impact, Waller criticized this newer version of Punk as being soft and claimed that modern opponents lack the toughness to properly challenge him. Maintaining his characteristic heel persona, Waller expressed a desire to face the old, dangerous version of Punk to test his own skills against the best in the world.

stories.title: Dave Bautista and stars mock Steve Corino ahead of Paul Walter Hauser match
stories.tldr: Actor Paul Walter Hauser has enlisted a star-studded lineup of Hollywood celebrities, including Dave Bautista, Johnny Knoxville, and Matthew Lillard, to mock WWE NXT coach and former ECW World Champion Steve Corino ahead of their upcoming PWF Undisputed Championship match on September 20. In a promotional video, the stars hilariously feigned ignorance and hurled insults at Corino, questioning his identity and forgetting his name. Despite the heavy roasting and Hollywood-led banter, Hauser acknowledged Corino's legendary wrestling history while still promising to capture the championship in North Carolina.

stories.title: Jake The Snake Roberts names WWE star he would like to wrestle today
stories.tldr: During a recent podcast appearance, WWE Hall of Famer Jake The Snake Roberts revealed that Randy Orton is the current star he would most like to wrestle if he ever came out of retirement. While Roberts has not competed in the ring since 2018, he is eager to face the Viper in a dream matchup. Meanwhile, Orton remains heavily active in WWE television following a recent victory over Cody Rhodes.

stories.title: Natalya rejects Ronda Rousey comparisons regarding new 'Natty' persona
stories.tldr: Natalya is addressing fan comparisons between her new aggressive Natty character and Ronda Rousey's MMA-inspired WWE persona. She clarifies that her new presentation is not an attempt to reenact an MMA gimmick or copy Rousey. Instead, Natalya reveals the true origin of the character stems from her roots in Stu Hart's legendary Dungeon and her experience with Bloodsport. She hopes WWE provides more television time to fully explain this transformation and her shift toward a more unapologetic veteran attitude.

stories.title: WWE considering future plans for Dominik Mysterio after Judgment Day
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly considering moving Dominik Mysterio away from The Judgment Day as his fourth anniversary with the faction approaches. Mysterio has allegedly expressed frustration over his comedic presentation in WWE compared to his serious, top-heel run as the AAA Mega Champion. Transitioning away from the group, dropping his current ladies man gimmick, and taking a potential leave of absence could pave the way for a more serious main event push and a future world championship pursuit.

stories.title: WWE set for double TV tapings in New York City this November
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly planning a double taping of both Raw and SmackDown at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn on Monday, November 2. This unusual scheduling is designed to accommodate the company's upcoming trip to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for the Crown Jewel Premium Live Event on November 7. The pre-taped SmackDown episode will air on Friday, just one day before the overseas PLE takes place. This logistics shift comes as WWE approaches the twilight of its ten-year partnership with Saudi Arabia, though TKO leadership has expressed a desire to continue promoting events in the Middle East.

stories.title: MVP defends promotion practice of adding injury time to contracts
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestler MVP recently discussed the business justification behind professional wrestling promotions adding injury time to performer contracts on his podcast Marking Out with MVP and Dwayne Swayze. He explained that the practice allows companies to recover time where a wrestler was paid while unable to perform due to injury, famously describing it as reclaiming their time. MVP also noted that promotions have the discretion to waive these extensions and that decisions are made on a case-by-case basis. His comments were general observations about industry practices rather than commentary on any specific talent's agreement.

stories.title: Brie Bella reveals costly music claim resulting from Instagram Reel
stories.tldr: Brie Bella recently revealed that a short ten second Instagram reel featuring a wine bottle resulted in a costly music copyright claim. Speaking on an episode of The Nikki and Brie Show, she explained that she was not even promoting the wine to viewers when the issue arose. The legal claim came from a company that had acquired the rights to the track rather than the recording artist directly. Although she kept the exact financial settlement private, Bella emphasized that she was forced to pay a substantial amount of money over the brief video clip.

stories.title: Vince Russo calls for WWE to reserve announce-table spots for big moments
stories.tldr: Former wrestling writer Vince Russo recently discussed the overuse of announce-table spots on wrestling shows during an appearance on Coach and Bro. He argued that utilizing this high-impact spot in multiple matches throughout a single card diminishes its overall significance and excitement for the fans. To restore value to these dangerous sequences, Russo believes WWE should reserve them exclusively for the most important matches of the evening. As a prime example, he noted that the main event between Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton deserved to feature a unique high-spot that the preceding matches had not already exposed the audience to.

stories.title: Jonathan Coachman questions Jade Cargill's progress on WWE main roster
stories.tldr: Former WWE personality Jonathan Coachman recently expressed concerns regarding Jade Cargill's current development on the main roster. During an episode of Coach and Bro, he argued that her character work and in-ring execution have not progressed as expected for someone in such a prominent position. Coachman compared her unfavorably to other performers like Tatum Paxley and Fatal Influence, whom he believes possess much more advanced character skills. Ultimately, he suggested that WWE management should reevaluate her high-ranking spot in the women division.

stories.title: Joe Hendry reveals tracklist for upcoming debut album Beyond Belief
stories.tldr: Joe Hendry has released the official seven-song tracklist for his upcoming WWE debut album, Beyond Belief, arriving on October 5. The project features comedic and wrestling-themed titles such as Give Joe Hendry Every Single Belt, Tables, Ladders and Chairs, and Fire Logan Paul. Analysts are already speculating on potential guest appearances, ranging from musical crossover stars like Lil Yachty and Bad Bunny to fellow WWE talent like R-Truth, John Cena, and Danhausen.

stories.title: Trick Williams discusses Magic City collaboration, US Title open challenges, and NXT mentors
stories.tldr: United States Champion Trick Williams recently addressed WWE's controversial Magic City merchandise crossover, joking that the partnership was a natural fit for Mr. Lemon Pepper Stepper. In a recent interview, Williams also explained that he discontinued his open challenges because potential contenders must earn their spot instead of receiving handouts. Furthermore, he credited legends Booker T and Shawn Michaels for teaching him how to maximize camera angles and prioritize crowd reactions during his rise in NXT.

stories.title: WWE NXT September 8 episode news, reports, and digital viewership
stories.tldr: Beyond the commentary easter eggs on the September 8 episode of NXT, the broadcast set the stage for several major storyline developments and matches. Kelani Jordan successfully defended her title before being laid out by Wren Sinclair, who was subsequently suspended. Furthermore, digital metrics reveal that the BirthRight and Zilla Fatu angle is heavily dominating online viewership, significantly outpacing traditional match highlights.

stories.title: AJ Styles offers advice on wrestling identity and working to WWE cameras
stories.tldr: Expanding on his recent NXT coaching efforts, AJ Styles is now sharing broader professional advice regarding match psychology and television production. On his show, Styles urged developmental talents to build unique identities by avoiding borrowed moves and pacing their matches around what has already happened earlier on the card. He also defended WWE strict focus on working toward the hard camera, arguing that catering to the home viewing audience remains essential regardless of past outside experience.

stories.title: AJ Lee explains why she stopped watching pro wrestling during decade away
stories.tldr: AJ Lee recently discussed her decade-long absence from professional wrestling, comparing her complete avoidance of the product to avoiding an ex-partner after a painful breakup. She revealed that lingering trauma and a broken heart kept her away until she briefly tuned in to support her husband, CM Punk. That experiment ended abruptly when Punk was injured on the show she watched, leading her to believe watching brought bad juju.

stories.title: John Cena reflects on world title record chase and Cody Rhodes gaming rivalry
stories.tldr: Building on his recent reflections, John Cena revealed that breaking the world title record at WrestleMania was ultimately more important for WWE business than for his personal legacy. He also hopes a younger star will eventually break his new record so he can hand over the torch. Additionally, Cena drew a parallel between his real-life mobile gaming rivalry with Cody Rhodes and their on-screen WWE feud, comparing their Clash of Clans progression to a student-and-teacher dynamic.

stories.title: TJP and Lince Dorado express interest in another WWE Cruiserweight Classic
stories.tldr: TJ Perkins and Lince Dorado recently stumbled upon the original WWE Cruiserweight Classic trophy in a storage warehouse. Inspired by the upcoming ten-year anniversary of the 2016 tournament, TJP revealed they want to pitch a brand new edition to the company. TJP expressed interest in hosting the potential revival and noted that today's emerging talent makes it the perfect time for a comeback.

stories.title: Bully Ray criticizes presentation of 946 on WWE Raw
stories.tldr: Following their recent debut, the newly formed stable 946 made a major statement on WWE Raw by setting fire to a vehicle belonging to the Usos and Jacob Fatu. While Hall of Famer Bully Ray praised the group's overall presentation and physical dominance in their ongoing feud, he criticized the car-burning angle on Busted Open Radio as outdated Vince McMahon-style booking that failed to give fans a reason to boo the heels. Overall, Ray remains high on the faction's potential, highlighting the exciting singles and tag team matches the rivalry can produce moving forward.

stories.title: WWE prepares stacked lineup for SmackDown in Mexico City
stories.tldr: The stacked SmackDown card in Mexico City features five total matches and four championships on the line alongside potential major booking surprises. Speculation points to Damian Priest turning heel on R-Truth following an AAA tag title match, and Tiffany Stratton potentially costing Chelsea Green her women's title against Nia Jax. Additionally, returning star Johnny Gargano could factor into the main event to help Sami Zayn finally capture the Undisputed WWE Championship from CM Punk.

stories.title: AJ Styles reacts to NXT Heatwave atmosphere and AAA fan turnout
stories.tldr: AJ Styles recently shared his perspective on the unique atmosphere surrounding the recent events involving AAA and NXT. Speaking on his podcast, he noted that the crowd near the Texas border featured a heavy presence of AAA supporters compared to NXT loyalists. He also discussed Heatwave acting as a brand reset and shared his thoughts on which developmental talents might soon be ready for main roster call-ups.

stories.title: Bronson Reed comments on potential WWE matchup against Oba Femi
stories.tldr: Following his recent return and devastating attacks on Oba Femi, Bronson Reed has set his sights squarely on the rising star, declaring his intention to conquer what he views as the current mountain in WWE. Speaking on WWE Now, Reed drew comparisons to past victories over elite talent like Kazuchika Okada and Roman Reigns as proof that he can take down the seemingly unbeatable. He also reaffirmed his support for stablemate Bron Breakker as the future of the company while positioning himself as the present and a future world champion.

stories.title: Speculation mounts regarding new male member joining The Judgment Day
stories.tldr: As speculation grows about adding a new male member to revitalize the stagnant Judgment Day, three potential candidates have emerged for the stable. Speculation points toward AAA ally Omos, recently returned powerhouse Big Cass, or former member Damian Priest following a potential heel turn. Adding any of these stars could immediately restore a much-needed physical presence to the men's side of the faction.

stories.title: Backstage direction for Cody Rhodes vs. Randy Orton rivalry continuation
stories.tldr: Randy Orton recently defeated Cody Rhodes at Sunday Night’s Main Event following a chaotic finish, extending their ongoing program which stems from the wrestlers' own desire to work together. This feud continues to serve as a holding pattern to keep both men away from Undisputed WWE Champion CM Punk, who has other challengers lined up first. Backstage officials view the rivalry as major-event worthy, though its physical nature and cartoonish referee bumps drew some mixed reactions. Both Rhodes and Orton are still eventually expected to reenter the world title picture once the timing aligns.

stories.title: Zilla Fatu credits family member for inspiring debut WWE NXT promo
stories.tldr: Following his explosive physical clash on WWE NXT, Zilla Fatu is opening up about the creative choices behind his milestone television appearance. In a recent YouTube vlog, the newest NXT signee confirmed that his debut gear was a deliberate homage to his famous cousin, The Rock. Fatu also reflected on the surreal experience during a podcast appearance with Booker T, revealing that he felt his late father Umaga watching over him in spirit as he stepped out in front of the live crowd.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes includes Randy Orton among wrestling's 'Golden Circle'
stories.tldr: Despite their bitter rivalry, Cody Rhodes has placed Randy Orton alongside John Cena in an elite wrestling golden circle. Rhodes praised Orton's unmatched consistency and unpredictability as what makes him truly dangerous in the ring. Outside of sports entertainment, Rhodes also opened up about his transition into Hollywood with upcoming roles in the Street Fighter film and a cameo alongside Liam Neeson in The Naked Gun.

stories.title: Ric Flair criticizes modern wrestlers making millions via social media marketing
stories.tldr: During an appearance on Booker T's podcast, WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair strongly criticized modern professional wrestlers who generate millions of dollars through social media marketing rather than in-ring talent. Flair argued that many of these digital-age performers lack the stamina and wrestling ability of past generations and could not survive a thirty-minute match. While Flair viewed this trend with frustration, Booker T offered a more balanced perspective, calling social media both a blessing and a curse for the industry while praising stars like MJF for successfully maintaining a heel persona online.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett to face Blue Panther at CMLL 93rd Anniversary Show
stories.tldr: Jeff Jarrett appeared via video during the September 9th episode of CMLL Informa to issue a direct challenge to Blue Panther for a match at the upcoming CMLL 93rd Aniversario show. The monumental event is scheduled to take place on September 18th at the historic Arena México. Additionally, CMLL announced an interpromotional six-woman tag team match featuring STARDOM talents. Fans can look forward to seeing Maika, Ema Maishima, and Mei Seira battle Sanely, Candela, and Kira on the big anniversary card.

stories.title: RevPro owner explains decision on Leon Slater match broadcast during AEW All In weekend
stories.tldr: RevPro owner Andy Quildan recently addressed why TNA star Leon Slater's match from AEW All In weekend was withheld from the MyAEW broadcast. Quildan explained that he made the preemptive decision himself to avoid potential political complications regarding TNA talent involvement amidst recent tensions between major promotions. Although he later released the match on YouTube, Quildan admitted that hindsight suggests his caution may have inadvertently drawn more attention to the situation.

stories.title: Dr. Debra Katz discusses clairvoyance on After Dark Radio
stories.tldr: After Dark Radio recently featured special guest Dr. Debra Katz to discuss the fascinating topics of clairvoyance and remote viewing. Host Bryan Alvarez explored the history of these practices, the differences between them, and whether everyday people can learn how to do them. The conversation also touched upon why psychics often face criticism for failing to locate missing individuals such as Nancy Guthrie.

stories.title: Stardom introduces Jimbo Bonji as new English play-by-play commentator
stories.tldr: Japanese women's wrestling promotion Stardom has added bilingual voice actor Jimbo Bonji as a new English-language commentator starting this weekend. Bonji will debut at the Stardom to the World pay-per-view on September 12 from Yokohama Budokan. He will share duties with existing commentator Walker Stewart, with both men occasionally teaming up at the desk to ensure live English coverage for every possible event. Stewart welcomed the addition on social media while confirming that he will continue with the promotion as well.

stories.title: El Hijo del Vikingo shares positive rehabilitation update and thanks WWE and AAA
stories.tldr: Lucha libre star El Hijo del Vikingo has provided an encouraging update on his ongoing physical rehabilitation following an injury. In a recent social media post, he expressed deep gratitude to the people and promotions standing by him during his recovery. Notably, Vikingo thanked both AAA and WWE for their support, while also crediting his therapist and his wife for helping him through the difficult process.

stories.title: Looking back at TNA No Surrender 2007 and Pacman Jones title win
stories.tldr: On September 9, 2007, at TNA No Surrender, controversial NFL player Adam Pacman Jones won the TNA World Tag Team Titles alongside Ron Killings. Because his contract with the Tennessee Titans prohibited him from physically wrestling, Jones won the championship without ever taking a bump or executing a move. The bizarre title change culminated in a widely panned match against Kurt Angle and Sting that featured a contrived distraction finish. Historical reviews famously rated the dubious encounter just half a star.

stories.title: Tessa Blanchard CMLL schedule updates and MLW booking changes
stories.tldr: Following her sudden removal from Major League Wrestling, Tessa Blanchard has been officially booked for a high-profile singles match against STARDOM standout Starlight Kid for CMLL in Mexico City on September 12, the exact date of her canceled MLW debut. Reports indicate that CMLL ultimately pulled Blanchard from the MLW appearance due to contract obligations, despite an established working relationship between the two promotions. Additionally, Blanchard is slated to challenge for the CMLL Women's World Championship later in the month at the promotion's 93rd Aniversario event.

stories.title: Daily Wrestling Observer news updates and audio reports
stories.tldr: Following recent industry updates, the latest wrestling news covers extensive fallout from AEW All In, audio reports featuring Tom Lawlor, and a special Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite supporting ALS awareness. Additional updates feature CM Punk on Hot Ones, Joe Hendry previewing his upcoming album, and various talent and international territory news.

stories.title: AAA Triplemania 34 match cards and global broadcast start times
stories.tldr: The full match card and global broadcast start times for Night 2 of AAA Triplemania 34 in Mexico City have been revealed. The September 13 event features Dominik Mysterio defending the AAA Mega Title against El Grande Americano in the main event. Additional championship bouts and a Mexican Street Fight round out the card, alongside confirmed start times for fans worldwide.

stories.title: Historical pro wrestling retrospective: Top matches and title changes on September 9
stories.tldr: Shifting to September 9, the historical retrospective highlights another stacked lineup of top-rated matches and major championship changes. Standout bouts include a praised NJPW clash between HENARE and Hiromu Takahashi and an acclaimed IWA Mid-South battle with Arik Cannon and Chris Hero. Additionally, the date boasts nearly 300 historical title changes, highlighted by iconic reigns from Harley Race, Shane Douglas, and even NFL player Pacman Jones.

stories.title: AEW reportedly in talks to sign free agent Kairi Sane after WWE exit
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Kairi Sane remains a high-profile free agent following her surprising release from the company in April. While All Elite Wrestling has held discussions with the former champion regarding a potential signing, no official deal has been finalized yet. Multiple promotions both in the United States and abroad are also pursuing her services, though she is not expected to land at Japan's Marigold promotion. Furthermore, she was never seriously factored into creative plans for the recent All In event in London.

stories.title: AEW's Harley Cameron moves into AMP House with Agent00
stories.tldr: AEW wrestler Harley Cameron recently made a surprise appearance on a Twitch stream where Agent00 introduced her as his new roommate at the Atlanta AMP house. The crossover sparked massive online reactions, though conflicting reports have emerged over whether her claim about moving in was an actual life change or just a joke. This intersection bridges professional wrestling and the elite streaming world, following previous crossovers like Kai Cenat appearing on WWE programming.

stories.title: AEW announces 'All Out Afternoon Block Party' event in Chicago
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a free All Out Afternoon Block Party on Saturday, September 26, 2026, at the Hideaway Brew Garden and Bar in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, prior to the All Out pay-per-view at the nearby NOW Arena. The pre-show event will feature live music, talent Q and As, photo booths, giveaways, and a dunk booth benefiting the Rebel Heart ALS fundraiser. This Chicago-area show coincides head-to-head with a WWE and AAA Worlds Collide event at the Allstate Arena just 20 minutes away, which features hometown star CM Punk. Meanwhile, the All Out card is filling up with high-profile matches, including Will Ospreay defending the Men's World Championship against Jon Moxley, a three-way tag team ladder match, and a Chicago Street Fight.

stories.title: Kevin Knight discusses wrestling influences and AEW Rebel Heart special
stories.tldr: Former AEW TNT Champion Kevin Knight recently discussed his wrestling inspirations, blending the styles of Mr. Perfect, The Rock, and Jeff Hardy with the energetic promos of NFL legends Deion Sanders and Cam Newton. During a promotional appearance on 11Alive ahead of AEW's Rebel Heart special in Athens, Georgia, Knight also spoke about honoring the late Andy Williams and supporting Tanea Brooks in her battle with ALS. At the upcoming event, Knight will team up with Kyle Fletcher to face The Young Bucks in a tables match to help raise money for ALS research.

stories.title: Kyle Fletcher discusses recovery from leg injury ahead of AEW comeback
stories.tldr: AEW star Kyle Fletcher recently reflected on his grueling recovery from a severe leg injury suffered in March, which included a torn meniscus, fractured tibia, and fractured ankle. Despite an uncertain recovery timeline, his primary motivation throughout rehab was making it back in time to compete at AEW All In at Wembley Stadium. After avoiding surgery and returning ahead of schedule, he defended the AEW International Championship in a Triple Threat match against Kazuchika Okada and Konosuke Takeshita. Although he ultimately lost the title to Okada, Fletcher described the unforgettable event as one of the greatest days of his life and remains focused on future world championship goals.

stories.title: Jin Tala makes ROH television taping debut
stories.tldr: Former WWE developmental talent Jin Tala, now performing under her real name Leigh Laurel, made her Ring of Honor television taping debut against Cassie Lee at WJCT Studios. Following her October release, Laurel spent nearly a year sharpening her wrestling, promos, and character work on the independent circuit to prepare for major opportunities in promotions like ROH, AEW, or TNA. While she has expressed openness to eventually returning to WWE as a more polished performer, it remains unconfirmed if she has officially signed with ROH. Her high-profile debut against an experienced opponent like Lee provides an immediate platform to showcase her post-WWE growth.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland explains evolution of ring psychology in pro wrestling
stories.tldr: AEW star Swerve Strickland recently discussed how professional wrestling psychology has evolved over the years during a recent interview. He explained that unlike past eras that relied on a universal blanket structure, modern wrestlers adapt their psychology and selling based on specific opponents, character dynamics, and personal feuds. Strickland will put these philosophies into practice on the upcoming episode of AEW Dynamite during a World Trios Championship defense.

stories.title: AEW character direction shifts as top stars turn babyface
stories.tldr: Over the past few weeks, AEW has shifted several top names like Kenny Omega, Jon Moxley, and Swerve Strickland from heels to babyfaces. Building on this momentum, additional roster members are positioned to make similar character transitions soon. Potential upcoming face turns include Kyle Fletcher breaking away from the Don Callis Family, Samoa Joe pivoting The Opps, and the Triangle of Madness entering the women's title picture.

stories.title: Grizzled Young Veterans scheduled to wrestle CPF at RevPro event
stories.tldr: The Grizzled Young Veterans, consisting of Zack Gibson and James Drake, are scheduled to return to the British independent wrestling scene this weekend to face CPF members Danny Black and Joe Lando at a RevPro event in Stevenage. While the duo has recently appeared mostly on Ring of Honor programming and their exact AEW contract status remains unconfirmed, this match marks their first UK appearance since December 2025. Their opponents, Black and Lando, are prominent UK high-flyers who previously performed at RevPro's major event at Wembley Arena during All In weekend.

stories.title: ROH and AEW pay tribute to Andy 'The Butcher' Williams following his death
stories.tldr: Tony Khan and Ring of Honor honored the late Andy Williams with a ten-bell salute and memorial graphic during their television tapings, while the Millvale Police Department released an official timeline of the emergency response. According to police, officers arrived to find two physicians attending to an unresponsive Williams before he was transported to the hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Investigators confirmed there were no visible signs of trauma or foul play, and the official cause of death remains pending the results of an autopsy by the Allegheny County Medical Examiner's Office.

stories.title: Steven Borden's wrestling potential evaluated after AEW All In appearance
stories.tldr: As Steven Borden prepares for his upcoming televised tag team match, analysts are heavily evaluating his potential to carry the legacy of his father, Sting. Borden initially pursued a football career rather than wrestling, playing tight end at the University of Kentucky and trying out for the Kansas City Chiefs before catching the wrestling bug during his father's retirement events. After receiving extensive training from Darby Allin, Adam Copeland, and other veterans, Borden quietly wrestled his first match in New York last year. Now, the young prospect faces the ultimate test of whether he can forge his own path in AEW or be crushed by the immense weight of his family name.

stories.title: TKO Executive Mark Shapiro discusses talent pay cuts, Disney events, and Middle East expansion
stories.tldr: TKO President and COO Mark Shapiro addressed several major company initiatives during a recent investor conference appearance. He confirmed that WWE and UFC talent pay was resized following major media rights deals, but expressed confidence in the current financial structure. Shapiro also teased family-focused crossover events between WWE and Disney for 2027 and highlighted strong ongoing demand for TKO events in the Middle East.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes mourns the passing of his dog Pharaoh
stories.tldr: WWE star Cody Rhodes has announced the passing of his beloved longtime husky, Pharaoh, sharing an emotional tribute on Instagram detailing their decade together. Pharaoh became a fixture in the wrestling world, accompanying Rhodes across WWE and AEW, appearing on merchandise, and even getting pulled into a recent storyline feud with Randy Orton. Rhodes fondly remembered Pharaoh as a crisis dog who supported him through major life events, such as the death of his father Dusty Rhodes, and ultimately found his true purpose protecting Cody and Brandi's daughter, Liberty.

stories.title: Glenn Jacobs (Kane) considered for US Senate appointment
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Glenn Jacobs, known in the wrestling ring as Kane, could be entering a major new chapter in his political career following the conclusion of his second term as mayor of Knox County, Tennessee. Reports indicate that Jacobs is viewed as a top candidate for a United States Senate appointment if current Senator Marsha Blackburn wins the upcoming gubernatorial election in November. Blackburn plans to appoint her own temporary replacement if she takes office as governor in January, with Jacobs, Tim Burchett, and Chuck Fleischmann among the rumored contenders. While Jacobs has received praise from President Donald Trump and remains in the mix, Blackburn's campaign has stated no official discussions will happen until the appropriate time.

stories.title: Dave Meltzer analyzes WWE Raw's failure to hit Netflix Top 10
stories.tldr: The August 31, 2026 episode of WWE Raw surprisingly missed Netflix global and United States top ten rankings for the first time since February, failing to chart with fewer than the usual 1.8 million minimum global views. Dave Meltzer analyzed this dip alongside early shifts in Nielsen ratings affecting wrestling, while Netflix Vice President Gabe Spitzer expressed that the streaming giant is otherwise thrilled with the partnership. Spitzer noted that Raw has hit every metric expected in the US, while international markets have exceeded expectations as the platform home for all WWE programming.

stories.title: Rob Conway disputes Randy Orton rumor and shares John Cena OVW stories
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Rob Conway recently reflected on training alongside John Cena in OVW and driving him to his historic 2002 SmackDown debut against Kurt Angle. He also disputed a longstanding story told by Randy Orton regarding their first gym meeting where Orton claimed Conway snubbed his handshake. Additionally, Conway discussed his original main roster plans to debut alongside Stevie Richards and Victoria before those plans were abruptly changed to form La Resistance.

stories.title: Birthright attacks Zilla Fatu on WWE NXT
stories.tldr: BirthRight's aggressive recruitment tactics on WWE NXT backfired when Zilla Fatu firmly rejected their invitation to join the group. After Ariana Grace provided a crucial distraction, Charlie Dempsey and his stablemates launched a vicious beatdown that culminated in Fatu being put through a table. In response, William Regal urged his son Charlie to handle the situation himself, prompting Shawn Michaels to officially book a one-on-one match between Fatu and Dempsey for the upcoming episode of NXT.

stories.title: WWE announces eight new Raw and SmackDown dates for late 2026
stories.tldr: WWE has announced eight new Raw and SmackDown dates for November and December of 2026, filling out the late-year touring schedule. The slate includes a special combined Raw and SmackDown taping in Wichita, Kansas, on Monday, November 23, which will serve as part of the go-home week for Survivor Series. Tickets for all eight events will go on sale to the general public on Friday, September 11, following an exclusive presale starting on Thursday, September 10. These new dates join a busy autumn calendar that features Crown Jewel in Riyadh, Survivor Series in Houston, and Wrestlepalooza in Perth, Australia.

stories.title: Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson releases emotional message on dementia and Free Byrd film
stories.tldr: Dwayne The Rock Johnson shared an emotional Instagram message reflecting on the heartbreak of dementia while discussing his upcoming action drama film Free Byrd. In the movie, announced in July, Johnson stars as a Las Vegas motorcycle stuntman hiding a dementia diagnosis from his brother before one final jump. The project is directed by Greg Kwedar and produced by Ben Affleck and Matt Damon through their company Artists Equity. A release date for the film has not yet been announced.

stories.title: Charlie Dempsey reaches breaking point on WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Charlie Dempsey reached a breaking point on WWE NXT, voicing deep frustration over the treatment of his faction BirthRight and taking aim at WWE favoring failed football players over real wrestlers. His grievances escalated into a brutal physical assault where BirthRight powerbombed Zilla Fatu through the announce table following Fatu's repeated rejection of their recruitment offers. The escalating rivalry was further fueled by WWE legend William Regal, Dempsey's father, who confronted BirthRight alongside Fit Finlay and ordered Dempsey to step up and face Fatu head-on in a high-stakes singles match.

stories.title: Myles Borne promises public apology to Tavion Heights on WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Myles Borne has officially promised to deliver a face-to-face public apology to his former tag team partner Tavion Heights on the upcoming episode of WWE NXT. The tension stems from NXT Heatwave on August 30, where Borne turned on Heights and hit him with a Borne Again slam after they lost the NXT Tag Team Championship and Borne lost his North American Championship. Following pressure from Hank Walker and Tank Ledger backstage on the September 8 episode, Borne agreed to properly address Heights in the ring next week. Furthermore, the September 15 card will feature a triple threat number one contender match for the NXT Championship between Mason Rook, Tony D'Angelo, and Saquon Shugars.

stories.title: IYO SKY and Chad Gable announced for NXT house show appearances
stories.tldr: WWE has announced that Monday Night Raw stars IYO SKY and Intercontinental Champion Chad Gable will make special appearances at upcoming NXT house shows later this month. The duo is scheduled to perform on September 26 in Columbia, South Carolina, and September 27 in Greensboro, North Carolina. While both athletes remain full-time members of the Raw roster and are currently juggling major storylines on Monday nights, they will briefly join the developmental brand's live-event tour. This cross-brand presence gives fans in those cities a rare opportunity to see established main-roster talent on the NXT road show.

stories.title: Jackson Drake retains NXT North American Title against Tavion Heights
stories.tldr: Jackson Drake successfully defended his NXT North American Championship against Tavion Heights on the September 8 episode of WWE NXT. Heights challenged for the gold to rebound from losing his tag titles and being betrayed by his former partner Myles Borne at Heatwave. Despite external interference and a relentless attack on his leg, Drake ultimately secured the victory by hitting a decisive 450 splash from the top rope. Following the match, Myles Borne appeared in the crowd to further torment Heights, leaving their personal rivalry unresolved.

stories.title: Je'Von Evans recalls backstage warning prior to facing Brock Lesnar
stories.tldr: WWE star JeVon Evans recently reflected on sharing the ring with Brock Lesnar during the 2026 men's Royal Rumble match in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Although Evans was excited and confident about taking his first F5, he admitted to being nervous beforehand. Fortunately, he overheard crucial backstage advice warning him not to jump when taking one of Lesnar's signature suplexes. Evans heeded the warning, later joking that attempting to jump would have been disastrous.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair discusses Alexa Bliss partnership hesitancy and family plans
stories.tldr: Charlotte Flair recently discussed her career and personal life during a podcast appearance. She revealed that both she and WWE creative initially doubted her on-screen partnership with Alexa Bliss due to their contrasting fan receptions, but the pairing ultimately succeeded. Additionally, Flair opened up about her future family plans, sharing her desire to become a mother and stating that she is open to adoption and fostering.

stories.title: Unreleased plans for Bray Wyatt and Bo Dallas in WWE
stories.tldr: According to Matt Hardy on his podcast, late wrestling star Bray Wyatt and his brother Bo Dallas were finally positioned to work together in a major WWE program before Wyatt's tragic passing. The brothers had wanted to collaborate on screen for years, sharing a close bond both in and out of the personal realm. While they previously crossed paths briefly when the B Team feuded with the Deleters of Worlds, a deeper storyline was ultimately stolen by the tragedy.

stories.title: Ric Flair claims WWE agent caused Big E's neck injury
stories.tldr: Ric Flair and Booker T recently discussed the 2022 incident on a podcast where Ridge Holland delivered a dangerous overhead belly-to-belly suplex to Big E on the floor, resulting in fractured C1 and C6 vertebrae that effectively ended his in-ring career. While Booker previously warned Big E about risky dives through the ropes, Flair shifted the blame backstage, arguing that a WWE agent should never have approved such a high-risk suplex to the outside for a 300-pound wrestler performed by someone without elite-level experience. Despite the severity of the injury, which doctors warned could have caused paralysis or death, Big E has publicly stated he holds no personal grudge against Holland, though his career remains over due to unhealed bone growth.

stories.title: Tate Wilder names Cody Rhodes and Kevin Owens as WWE dream opponents
stories.tldr: NXT up-and-comer Tate Wilder recently revealed that Cody Rhodes and Kevin Owens are his ultimate WWE dream opponents. Wilder, who joined WWE through the collegiate athlete recruitment program in 2025, also expressed a strong desire to face Grayson Waller following Waller's recent appearance on NXT. Having previously worked with Kevin Owens during his time as a mentor on WWE LFG, Wilder praised the veteran's unique style, unbelievable knowledge, and ability to refine the minute details of a match.

stories.title: Off-air results and dark match details before WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Before the September 8, 2026 episode of WWE NXT went live on The CW and Netflix, fans in the arena enjoyed two non-televised matches and a dramatic in-ring confrontation. Kale Dixon defeated independent wrestler Richard Purnell, who wrestles as Richard Adonis, using a kneeling Angels Wings. Additionally, WWE EVOLVE Womens Champion Nikkita Lyons was interrupted and attacked by Vanta The Unknown during a speech about her WWE journey, while Mariano secured a victory over Brooks Jensen with a 450 Splash.

stories.title: WWE reports delay in launching CM Punk title feuds against Rhodes and Orton
stories.tldr: WWE is intentionally delaying potential Undisputed WWE Championship feuds between CM Punk and both Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton. According to reports, Rhodes and Orton are currently wrapped up in their own personal rivalry to keep them occupied away from the title picture. This strategic cooling-off period allows WWE to save those massive matchups for bigger stages in the future while CM Punk defends his title against other stars like Sami Zayn and Gunther.

stories.title: JBL discusses work rate vs. drama in professional wrestling
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer JBL recently weighed in on the ongoing debate between in-ring work rate and dramatic storytelling in professional wrestling. Referencing Paul Heyman's thoughts on Brock Lesnar breaking The Undertaker's historic WrestleMania streak, JBL emphasized that emotional moments and character investment are far more important than technical sequences. Ultimately, the veteran argued that without compelling drama that makes fans care, a high work rate loses all of its impact.

stories.title: The Vanity Project becomes new WWE NXT Tag Team Champions
stories.tldr: At WWE NXT Heatwave 2026, Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes, known as The Vanity Project, defeated Tavion Heights and Myles Borne to capture their second NXT Tag Team Championships. Following this major victory, the new champions are looking to cement their legacy among the best duos in brand history. This has opened the door for several tag teams in the division to step up as potential challengers for the gold. Six different pairings have been identified as top contenders to face The Vanity Project in the near future.

stories.title: Analysis of character depth and booking on WWE Monday Night Raw
stories.tldr: Monday Night Raw recently featured an over-saturation of interchangeable heel factions like the Vision and the Judgment Day treading water with questionable booking decisions. Matches saw prominent stars and champions suffering strange losses, such as tag champion Austin Theory falling to Otis and JD McDonagh losing quickly to Joe Hendry. Amidst this stagnant faction warfare, the newly arrived trio known as the 946 have injected potential intrigue by immediately targeting main event players like the Bloodline. To truly break out of the current creative rut, the 946 need to secure a dominant winning streak and chase championship gold.

stories.title: Ernest Miller shares backstage photos from WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Ernest The Cat Miller recently attended WWE Sunday Night's Main Event in Atlanta as an invited guest of the company. During his backstage visit, the veteran posed for photographs with several top roster members including Randy Orton, Jade Cargill, and Logan Paul. Miller also took time to give a pep talk to rapper Lil Yachty prior to his in-ring debut against Baron Corbin. The appearance highlighted Miller's enduring ties to the industry following his brief return to the squared circle earlier this year.

stories.title: Injured WWE stars nearing return to Raw, SmackDown, and NXT
stories.tldr: Following Bronson Reed's recent return to action, attention is turning toward which injured WWE superstars could make their comebacks next across Raw, SmackDown, and NXT. Logan Paul is reportedly three months ahead of schedule in his recovery from a tricep tear and aims to rejoin The Vision. Meanwhile, Elio LeFleur is nearing the end of his recovery from a torn labrum for an anticipated return to the NXT brand, and Rhea Ripley continues recovering from knee surgery to set up a future title unification match against Interim Champion Chelsea Green.

stories.title: Free agent signings expected to boost WWE NXT roster
stories.tldr: The WWE NXT roster is expected to receive further reinforcements before the end of 2026 following a busy year of roster movement. Speculation has pointed toward three potential free agent signings, including AEW star Anthony Bowens whose contract reportedly expires in October. Other names heavily linked with the brand include independent standout Richard Holliday and former Cruiserweight Champion Enzo Amore.

stories.title: NXT locker room reacts to Grayson Waller praising women's division
stories.tldr: NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan recently reacted to Grayson Waller's surprising comments on WWE NXT where he claimed the women's division has completely lapped the men. While the women appreciated the praise and the division's ongoing success highlighted by main events and long match times, Jordan noted that the remarks likely angered the male locker room and gave them a bigger chip on their shoulder. Jordan is now preparing for her upcoming title defense against Jaida Parker scheduled for the September 8 episode of WWE NXT.

stories.title: WWE Shop opens reservations for Money in the Bank canvas collectibles
stories.tldr: WWE Shop is now accepting reservations for a high-end personalized Name On Canvas collage tied to the upcoming Money in the Bank 2026 event. Priced at $299.99 through Fanatics Authentic, the framed 10-by-20-inch collectible is scheduled to ship on or before November 6 and includes a certificate of authenticity. Buyers must adhere to strict guidelines, submitting only a first and last name that matches government-issued identification for the final sale item. The event itself is officially scheduled for October 10 at the Smoothie King Center in New Orleans.

stories.title: WWE NXT viewing details and start time
stories.tldr: WWE NXT broadcasts live tonight on the CW network with its usual start time of 8pm Eastern. Fans across the United States can also tune in at 7pm Central and 5pm Pacific. International viewers will need to adjust their schedules depending on their region, as the show airs late night or early morning abroad. A complete global schedule is available to help fans worldwide catch the action live.

stories.title: What the YouTube metrics for WWE RAW tell us this week (September 7 2026)
stories.tldr: An analysis of YouTube metrics following the September 7, 2026 episode of WWE RAW reveals what segments are driving the most casual viewer interest. A violent angle involving The 946 setting The Usos car on fire dominated the charts, pulling in nearly triple the median views of other uploads. Meanwhile, storylines involving The Vision and Oba Femi continued to draw strong numbers, while midcard segments featuring Joe Hendry and JD McDonagh underperformed significantly, partly due to weaker video title framing.

stories.title: Bayley returns to WWE Raw amid conflicting contract update reports
stories.tldr: Following her recent surprise return to WWE Raw, conflicting reports have emerged regarding Bayley's current contract status. While Dave Meltzer reported that she signed a brand new deal with the company, PWInsider has strongly disputed this claim, citing sources who state no negotiations took place because she still has significant time left on her existing agreement. Regardless of the backstage contract chatter, it is confirmed that Bayley is back on the road as a full-time member of the Raw roster.

stories.title: Mason Rook, Tony D'Angelo, and Saquon Shugars set for NXT No. 1 Contender Match
stories.tldr: Mason Rook, Tony D'Angelo, and Saquon Shugars punched their tickets to a triple threat number one contender match by winning a six-man tag team main event on NXT. The finish saw Rook blind-tag himself in and use D'Angelo to hit a decisive move on EK Prosper, immediately sparking tension among the temporary allies. Next week's lineup will also feature Kali Armstrong versus Lizzy Rain, Darkstate taking on Sean Legacy and Dorian Van Dux, and Myles Borne issuing a public apology to Tavion Heights.

stories.title: Kelani Jordan retains NXT Women's Championship against Wren Sinclair and qualifies for MITB
stories.tldr: NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan successfully defended her title against Jaida Parker on the September 8 episode of NXT. Following the match, Jordan was brutally attacked by Wren Sinclair, who sought revenge for her friend Kendal Grey being put on the shelf. Consequently, NXT General Manager Robert Stone suspended Sinclair, while Jordan now turns her attention toward an upcoming Women's Money in the Bank qualifier on Raw.

stories.title: The New Level mentioned on WWE NXT by Vic Joseph
stories.tldr: During the September 8 episode of WWE NXT, commentator Vic Joseph made a subtle on-air reference to the recently rebranded AEW stars Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed. Speaking to NXT Champion Grayson Waller, Joseph used wordplay alluding to his past WWE association with the duo now known as The New Level. Meanwhile, in AEW, Ace Austin recently expressed his admiration for Kofi and predicted a future collision between The New Level and the Bang Bang Gang.

stories.title: WWE developmental releases lead to potential retirement for several wrestlers
stories.tldr: Following recent WWE developmental cuts, several released talents face uncertainty regarding their futures in the industry. While established veterans are expected to continue wrestling elsewhere, analysts predict that many raw Performance Center recruits will walk away from the sport entirely. Additionally, specific talents like Zena Sterling have officially confirmed that their next chapters will take place outside of the ring.

stories.title: Bronson Reed defends Tsunami finisher efficacy following weight loss
stories.tldr: Following his dramatic 100-pound weight loss and return to WWE at Sunday Night's Main Event, Bronson Reed has addressed online critics questioning the effectiveness of his Tsunami finisher. Reed defended the move by explaining that his lighter frame actually allows him to jump higher, travel further, and generate greater acceleration for an even more devastating impact. He also highlighted the Tsunami's flawless legacy, noting that no opponent has ever kicked out of the splash since he debuted it in NXT in 2019.

stories.title: Kelani Jordan and Carmelo Hayes set wedding rules
stories.tldr: Fresh off her historic NXT Women's Championship victory, Kelani Jordan is preparing for another major milestone as she marries fellow star Carmelo Hayes next month. However, despite their wrestling backgrounds, Jordan has strictly forbidden any table spots at the reception because the furniture is simply too expensive. She also praised Hayes as an incredible partner who constantly pushes and supports her in and out of the ring.

stories.title: Bully Ray discusses booking Cody Rhodes after SNME loss to Randy Orton
stories.tldr: Following his chaotic loss to Randy Orton at Sunday Night's Main Event, Cody Rhodes is facing heavy criticism for hesitating to use the punt kick. Wrestling veteran Bully Ray suggested that Rhodes needs to deliver a raw, accountability-driven apology to save his babyface character from wearing thin with fans. However, critics argue the damage is already permanent, especially since WWE ran the exact same hesitation-and-defeat trope with John Cena at WrestleMania 41.

stories.title: Oba Femi set to team up with WWE stars against The Vision faction
stories.tldr: After failing to fend off The Vision alone on Raw, Oba Femi is officially in search of allies to combat the dominant faction's numbers advantage. Wrestling analysts have pointed to three potential partnership options to even the odds. Alpha Academy, the hiatus-bound Street Profits, and Seth Rollins all emerge as prime candidates to step up and join forces with The Ruler.

stories.title: Ranking the top contenders for Grayson Waller's NXT Championship
stories.tldr: Following his NXT Championship victory, Grayson Waller is already facing a crowded field of challengers looking to dethrone him. Backstage reports indicate his title win was planned weeks in advance, while former champion Tony D'Angelo will remain on the brand without an immediate main roster call-up. The next challenger will now be decided through a series of matches starting with a six-man tag team bout. Six top contenders, including Tony D'Angelo, Cruz Montana, and Keanu Carver, have been ranked as the race for the title heats up.

stories.title: Sol Ruca promises ladder spot for Money in the Bank match
stories.tldr: Following her recent Money in the Bank qualification, Sol Ruca has vowed to hit her signature Sol Snatcher off a ladder at the upcoming premium live event. Ruca punched her ticket to the match by defeating Lyra Valkyria and Maxxine Dupri on Raw, aided by a timely interference from a returning Bayley. Additional qualifying matches have been announced for next week as the fields for both the men's and women's ladder matches begin to take shape.

stories.title: JBL claims Attitude Era depended on Scott Hall and Kevin Nash leaving WWE
stories.tldr: JBL recently shared his perspective on how the Monday Night War shaped professional wrestling history. He argued on a podcast that the Attitude Era would never have happened if Scott Hall and Kevin Nash had not left WWE for WCW. According to JBL, their departure forced WWE to completely revamp stagnant characters like Triple H, Stone Cold Steve Austin, and The Rock, ultimately sparking the creative revolution that saved the company.

stories.title: WWE World's Collide 2026 hits 10k ticket sales without announced card
stories.tldr: WWE Worlds Collide 2026 has officially crossed the ten thousand ticket milestone for its upcoming September show at the Allstate Arena despite having zero matches announced. The event continues to maintain a healthy lead over AEW All Out, which is running on the exact same night in the same state. New data shows WWE sitting at 10,149 distributed seats compared to All Out's 8,501. Resale tickets and entry-level pricing details have also emerged as the local head-to-head battle progresses.

stories.title: Ric Flair files $10 million lawsuit against FAM Networks talent agency
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair has filed a 10 million dollar lawsuit against the influencer talent agency FAM Networks in Manhattan Supreme Court. Flair alleges he was fraudulently induced into signing away a perpetual license to his name, image, likeness, and digital assets after being given just fourteen minutes to review the contract without legal counsel. The complaint states that FAM failed to deliver on contractual promises like generating six-figure monthly revenues and securing speaking engagements, while locking him out of his Facebook page and profiting off his persona. Flair is seeking at least 10 million dollars in damages, the rescission of the agreement, the return of his social media accounts, and a complete accounting of revenues generated in his name.

stories.title: AAA TripleMania 34 search interest, card, and global start times detailed
stories.tldr: AAA TripleMania 34 approaches with a massive two-night schedule starting September 11 at the MGM Grand Garden Arena in Las Vegas and concluding September 13 in Mexico City. While the company's year-over-year search interest has grown significantly, it has cooled off compared to the massive peak driven by the El Grande Americano feud earlier this year. Night one features a high-profile card headlined by Rey Mysterio facing Omos, alongside several championship matches and global start times for fans worldwide.

stories.title: Mercedes Martinez seeks financial aid for ACL surgery after AEW/WWE departure
stories.tldr: Former WWE and AEW star Mercedes Martinez has launched a GoFundMe campaign to raise $25,000 for required ACL surgery and rehabilitation following a career-ending ring injury on August 15, 2026. Because her major company contracts expired and she was working on the independent circuit without health insurance, she must pay for the medical procedures entirely out of pocket before they can be scheduled. The 45-year-old veteran had originally planned a final wrestling run through 2026, but the injury has left her unable to work and struggling to cover both medical expenses and everyday bills. Despite the abrupt end to her in-ring career, Martinez hopes to remain involved in the wrestling industry in a non-wrestling capacity once she has fully recovered.

stories.title: Zack Amico discusses JCW commentary role and potential Skankfest collaboration
stories.tldr: Zack Amico recently shared the unusual story of how he landed a commentary role with Juggalo Championship Wrestling after stepping in last-minute at Bloodymania. After impressing Violent J with his emergency work, Amico eventually found himself on a two-week road trip with the Insane Clown Posse. Furthermore, Amico revealed that talks are currently underway for a major collaboration between JCW and Skankfest. If finalized, Amico expects to be heavily involved in the crossover event.

stories.title: French wrestling legend Marc Mercier dies at age 68
stories.tldr: French professional wrestling legend Marc Mercier has passed away at the age of 68 following a battle with cancer, as announced by his son Hugo. Coming from a wrestling family, Mercier began his career in the 1970s, captured multiple European titles, and later became a pivotal promoter, trainer, and president of the French Professional Wrestling Federation. Outside of his contributions to the ring, he also worked as an actor and stuntman before officially retiring in 2024.

stories.title: Mystery Wrestling books event at Philadelphia's 2300 Arena
stories.tldr: Mystery Wrestling is expanding to the United States by booking its first-ever show at Philadelphia's iconic 2300 Arena, scheduled for November 28, 2026. The independent promotion, known for its roots in Quebec and recent international expansion, will stream the event live and for free on YouTube and Twitch. Tickets for Mystery Wrestling 31 go on sale September 17, 2026, marking a major milestone for the company following recent events in Canada and London.

stories.title: Ric Flair explains why he and Hulk Hogan never unionized wrestlers
stories.tldr: Ric Flair recently discussed on Booker T's Hall of Fame podcast why he and Hulk Hogan never unionized professional wrestling during the 1980s, despite being approached multiple times. Flair explained that the "show must go on" mentality makes wrestling one of the most insensitive businesses in the world regarding injuries. Ultimately, Flair and Hogan refused to lead unionization efforts because they feared being blackballed and replaced, realizing that even the biggest stars in the industry were ultimately viewed as expendable by promoters.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny Show reviews 1984 Mid-South Wrestling
